;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2018 Kizlyar church shooting]]
**A gunman kills five people and wounds several others at a church in [[Kizlyar]], [[Dagestan]], [[Russia]]. Police later shoot and kill him. [http://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-43105171 (BBC)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Iran Aseman Airlines Flight 3704]]
**An [[Iran Aseman Airlines]] [[ATR 72]] commercial aircraft carrying 59 passengers and 6 crew members crashes near the [[Iran]]ian town of [[Semirom]]. The airline reports that there are no survivors. [http://www.foxnews.com/world/2018/02/18/airliner-crashes-in-southern-iran-with-66-aboard-report.html (AP via Fox News)], [http://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-43103192 (BBC)]

;Law and crime
*[[Corruption in Latvia]]
**The [[Corruption Prevention and Combating Bureau]] detains the head of the [[Bank of Latvia]], [[Ilmārs Rimšēvičs]]. In response, [[Latvia]]'s [[Prime Minister of Latvia|Prime Minister]] [[Māris Kučinskis]] calls an emergency cabinet meeting but added there was no apparent threat to the Latvian financial system. [http://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-43105170 (BBC)]

;Sports
*[[2018 Monster Energy NASCAR Cup Series]]
**[[Austin Dillon]] wins the [[2018 Daytona 500|60th Daytona 500]]. [http://www.espn.com/racing/nascar/story/_/id/22495546/austin-dillon-wins-daytona-500-no-3 (ESPN)]
